title: Memory Crystal Telemetry Payload v1
description: Telemetry payload POSTed by the local Convex stack to the cloud control-plane at /api/cloud/telemetry/heartbeat and /api/cloud/telemetry/aggregate. Snake_case field names follow Convex HTTP-action conventions. No end-user memory content may appear in this payload (Principle 1). The `tenant_id` and `tenantId` fields carry the same value — snake_case is used in the wire payload to match Convex conventions; the camelCase alias is documented here for cross-reference with the Convex schema.

payloadVersion.description: Schema version literal. Always 'v1' for this schema. Bump to 'v2' when fields are added or types change; cloud must accept both versions during the transition window.

payloadId.description: Idempotency key for this specific payload submission. Must be a UUIDv4 or similarly collision-resistant identifier. Cloud deduplicates within a (tenantId, payloadId) pair — re-POSTing the same payloadId for the same tenant is a no-op (returns 200 without double-counting).

tenant_id.description: Cloud tenant identifier (Convex document ID of the tenants table row). Used as the primary partition key on the cloud side. Same value as tenantId — snake_case is canonical on the wire.

tenantId.description: Alias of tenant_id in camelCase for cross-reference with the Convex schema. Both fields must carry the same value. Cloud handler validates equality and rejects with 400 on mismatch.

mc_version.description: Semantic version string of the local Memory Crystal stack (e.g. '1.0.0'). Sourced from MC_VERSION env var baked into the Docker image at build time.

last_activity_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the most recent memory capture or session activity on the local stack. Used for idle-cull eligibility (M11) and the launchpad 'last seen' display.

memory_count.description: Total number of non-archived memory records in the local crystalMemories table at the time of payload generation.

archived_count.description: Total number of archived memory records in the local crystalMemories table.

captures_24h.description: Number of memory captures recorded in the 24-hour window ending at the time of payload generation.

storage_bytes.description: Approximate total storage consumed by the local Convex database in bytes. Sourced from the Convex /version or storage-stats API, or estimated from row counts if unavailable.

embedder.description: Embedding provider active on the local stack. 'none' when embeddings are disabled.

errors_24h.description: Count of MCP-layer errors (auth failures, tool errors, transport errors) logged in the 24-hour window. Sourced from the mcp.error.* counters in the local Convex metrics table.

online_since.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the local stack last came online (cloudflared tunnel established + Convex backend healthy). Reset on each cold start. Used for fleet uptime dashboards.
